text:
Hi everyone! 😊

For couples who have gone through the **partner visa process at Misrad Hapnim in Tel Aviv within the last two years**:

**How long did it take you to receive your B/1 visa (non-married couple) after submitting your complete application?**

I’d be especially interested in hearing about your recent experiences and the actual waiting times nowadays at the Tel Aviv branch (One partner has a European citizenship, the other is Israeli)). Thanks so much for sharing!
